raw_blocks: ADP — providing solutions that simplify work
Since our very beginnings, we’ve been at the forefront of payroll and HR innovation.
Today, as always, we're proud to design better ways to work, with people at the heart of everything we do.
At ADP, what we do is about people. Although we have a strong history of providing solutions for human resource challenges, we strive to do more than that.
We challenge ourselves to anticipate, think forward and take action in a way that empowers us to shape the changing world of work.
For over 75 years, we’ve led the way in defining the future of business solutions. ADP is proud to be named the 2026 Fortune® World's Most Admired Companies™ list again for 20 consecutive years*.

We are a comprehensive global provider of cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions that unite HR , payroll , talent , time , tax and benefits administration and a leader in business outsourcing services, analytics and compliance expertise.
Our unmatched experience, deep insights and cutting-edge technology have transformed human resources from a back-office administrative function to a strategic business advantage.
Learn more about our philosophy , success factors and why companies work with ADP.
Meet the people who are leading the charge in designing better ways of working for businesses across the globe.
We are committed to unlocking potential – not only for our clients and their businesses, but in our people, our communities and society as a whole.
Our Company Our Associates Our Clients Our Communities Our World
Our policies, procedures and procurement resources helped make us one of the 2026 Fortune® World’s Most Admired Companies™* 20 years in a row.
Learn about Supplier Diversity , Corporate Governance , Code of Ethics policies , and more.
We maintain the highest levels of data security and privacy, and educate and empower our clients to take measures to reduce risk.
Learn more about Data Security at ADP .
Learn more about Privacy at ADP .
ADP has partnered with the most exciting professional athletes. Our roster of accomplished competitors inspire us to perform at our best.

Whether on the field or in business, data and insights connect people to the things they care about. In sports, players rely on data to inform smarter decisions as they move from one maneuver to the next. And with data driven insights from ADP, our clients have the precise information they need today to have a competitive edge tomorrow.
